tools.name: okgate_spend_report
tools.description:
Read an agent log and report what it spent: totals, calls by tool and by class, estimated
dollars by rail, loops, the largest single run, and — for every overspend — the okgate
band whose cap would have stopped it, the exact cap, and the call that would have tripped
it.

Needs no account and no key.

tools.name: okgate_create_proxy
tools.description: Create a hosted okgate proxy in front of an MCP server. Returns the proxy id, the per-customer MCP URL and the proxy key (shown once). Point your agent's MCP client at the URL with `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Requires an account key.

tools.name: okgate_set_policy
tools.description: Replace a proxy's policy (YAML: mode, upstreams, classify, caps, loop, dry_run, approvals, alerts, chaos, drift). Validated before saving; takes effect within 30 seconds. Requires an account key.

tools.name: okgate_get_run
tools.description: The incident-shaped report for one run: counts (calls, reads, writes, faked, blocked, spend), the call timeline with decisions, dry-run mutations (what would have changed), ledger entries and the audit-chain verification. Requires an account key.

tools.name: okgate_export_audit
tools.description: Export a run's hash-chained audit entries (prev_hash, hash, redacted args) with the Merkle root, for disputes and questionnaires. Verify offline with sha256(prev_hash + canonical(entry)). Requires an account key.

tools.name: okgate_recommend_allowlist
tools.description: Least-privilege recommendation from the proxy's recorded calls: the minimal tool allowlist, argument keys used per tool, and the upstream tools never used (remove them first). No LLM call here; apply it in the dashboard. Requires an account key.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "okgate_create_proxy" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: okgate_get_pricing · Public sink: okgate_get_pricing · Destructive: okgate_spend_report, okgate_get_run, okgate_export_audit, okgate_recommend_allowlist.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: okgate_get_pricing · Public sink: okgate_get_pricing · Destructive: okgate_spend_report, okgate_get_run, okgate_export_audit, okgate_recommend_allowlist

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
